title: AWS to deploy Cerebras systems in its own data centers

sources.quote: In March 2026, we signed a term sheet with AWS, under which AWS will become the first hyperscaler to deploy Cerebras in its own data centers.

explain: Amazon Web Services signed a binding term sheet to lease and buy Cerebras AI inference systems for its own data centers, paired with Amazon's Trainium chips. Cerebras also agreed to give AWS a warrant for up to about 2.7 million shares tied to large purchases. No dollar value was given.
